Symptom.name: Cutting tool or pen does not move down
Symptom.description: The tool or Pen does not move down when cutting a file or they are delayed coming down at the beginning of a cut.

FailureMode.name: Tool or layer mapping is incorrect, or tool is not on the tool holder
FailureMode.description: The layer may not be mapped to a tool or the tool may not be on the tool holder.

CorrectiveAction.name: Correct the tool or layer mapping
CorrectiveAction.description: Drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: If the layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the tool holder then just click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.

evidence.quote: If the layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the
Verify the mapping of your tools and layers are mapped properly under each tool.
This can be caused by an electrical short, tool mapping in software or a problem with the power supply.

tool holder then just click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
